observations.title: Change skin from the in-game library
observations.player_action: Open Quick Skin from the title or pause menu, import a local skin or retrieve one by username, and select it.
observations.outcome: The chosen appearance can be managed in-game, including Classic/Slim model selection.
conditions: This is The Plum Team Quick Skin, not the unrelated Ryhon keybinding mod named quickskin.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Choose a static or animated cape
observations.player_action: Select a built-in cape or import a compatible static/GIF cape in the cape menu.
observations.outcome: The chosen cape can animate using a generated texture atlas; playback and resource limits are configurable.
